claims.statement: The .zshenv defines XDG base directories, maps tools including pi-lens global data, per-project data and global configuration to XDG locations, and constructs the PATH.
The .zshrc file dynamically detects the operating environment and loads specific aliases such as termux_aliases.zsh, arch_aliases.zsh, or fedora_aliases.zsh accordingly.
The .zshrc conditionally sources ~/.secrets/api_keys.zsh for secrets management without tracking them in version control.
